_comment: These rules have NOT been clinically validated. Requires review by a qualified clinician before public release.
clinical_disclaimer: These rules have NOT been clinically validated. Requires review by a qualified clinician before public release.

emergency: 🚨 Call 112 (or your local emergency services) IMMEDIATELY. Do not wait.
Sit or lie down in a comfortable position with support. Do NOT try to drive yourself.
Unlock your front door so emergency responders can enter without delay.
Stay calm, breathe slowly, and avoid any physical exertion or sudden movements.
Keep this screen visible to show arriving emergency medical responders.
Notify a family member or neighbor of your emergency immediately.
see_doctor_today: Visit a doctor, urgent care center, or emergency department TODAY.
Rest completely — avoid all physical exertion or strenuous activity.
If symptoms worsen, chest discomfort intensifies, or you feel faint, call 112 immediately.
Do not drive yourself — arrange transport with someone else.
Keep a log of your symptoms: onset time, triggers, and severity.
no_emergency_warning_signs: No emergency warning signs were identified from your answers. If symptoms continue, get worse, or you are worried, seek medical care.
Monitor your condition closely. If you develop chest pain, shortness of breath, cold sweats, or fainting, call 112 immediately.
Do not ignore persisting, recurring, or worsening symptoms.
Consult a qualified healthcare provider if you have underlying conditions or ongoing concerns.

lowest_tier_statement: No emergency warning signs were identified from your answers. If symptoms continue, get worse, or you are worried, seek medical care.

questions.text: Are you experiencing crushing, squeezing, heavy, or pressing chest pain?
questions.text_hi: क्या आप छाती में अत्यधिक दबाव, जकड़न या कुचलने जैसा दर्द महसूस कर रहे हैं?

questions.text: Does the pain radiate to your left arm, jaw, neck, back, or shoulder?
questions.text_hi: क्या दर्द आपके बाएं हाथ, जबड़े, गर्दन, पीठ या कंधे में फैल रहा है?

questions.text: Are you experiencing shortness of breath or breathlessness even while resting?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपको आराम करते समय भी सांस लेने में तकलीफ हो रही है?
questions.clinical_focus: Acute Pulmonary Edema / Heart Failure / STEMI

questions.text: Are you sweating profusely or having cold sweats (diaphoresis)?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपको बहुत अधिक पसीना आ रहा है या ठंडा पसीना निकल रहा है?

questions.text: Have you fainted, lost consciousness, or nearly fainted recently?
questions.text_hi: क्या आप हाल ही में बेहोश हुए हैं, चेतना खोई है, या चक्कर खाकर गिरने लगे हैं?

questions.text: Is your heart racing, pounding, fluttering, or beating irregularly?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपका दिल बहुत तेजी से धड़क रहा है, फड़क रहा है या अनियमित रूप से धड़क रहा है?

questions.text: Are you feeling nauseous, lightheaded, or dizzy?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपको मतली, सिर चकराना या चक्कर जैसा महसूस हो रहा है?

questions.text: Are you feeling confused, disoriented, or having sudden blurred vision?
questions.text_hi: क्या आप भ्रमित, दिशाहीन महसूस कर रहे हैं या अचानक धुंधला दिखाई दे रहा है?

questions.text: Are you 40 years of age or older?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपकी उम्र 40 वर्ष या उससे अधिक है?

questions.text: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपको मधुमेह (डायबिटीज) का निदान हुआ है?

questions.text: Do you have known heart disease (prior heart attack, stent, angina, or bypass)?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपको पहले से हृदय रोग का इतिहास है (जैसे दिल का दौरा, स्टेंट, एनजाइना या बाईपास)?

questions.text: Have these symptoms lasted for more than 1 hour or persisted continuously?
questions.text_hi: क्या ये लक्षण 1 घंटे से अधिक समय से हैं या लगातार बने हुए हैं?
